title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation in a rawQuery call in kotlin — review required
description: In kotlin, rawQuery receives a statement built with + concatenation. SQLite parses the result as SQL, so an injected quote or UNION ends the intended predicate and adds attacker-chosen logic. The API has no injection protection of its own; only bound arguments do.
applicability: kotlin Android apps that query SQLite directly instead of a typed DAO.
risk: Data disclosure, authentication bypass and destructive statements; HIGH severity.
